text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, as we stroll through the
shopping
district...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I detect a dense crowd of people
eighteen meters
and fifty-four
centimeters ahead of us. It appears
to
be...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring vacation and a deluxe
carrot
hamburger steak... I see.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In truth, I am currently on a mission to
seek an
appropriate gift for you to show
you my
"gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural. However, the task is
proving
much harder than predicted...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The issue is that a gift's appeal is
directly
correlated to its price, and my
finances are
unfortunately limited as a
student.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I believe that a prize from this
raffle
could supply me with a sufficient
gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon stares at a poster that
has all
the raffle's rules and regulations
written on it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reviewing raffle procedures. First, I must
obtain a
raffle ticket via a purchase...
Hm...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you in current need of daily

necessities such as a toothbrush, socks,
or
perhaps a handkerchief?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to be selfish, I tell her to go
out and
buy something for herself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have successfully acquired a raffle
ticket via
purchase of protein powder.
Proceeding to phase
two.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gives the tumbler's handle a
powerful spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete. Hot spring vacation
coupon
obtained.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Despite being fully cognizant of the
possibility of
winning the grand prize, I
am still experiencing
"amazement" over
this result.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I cannot fully believe that I won...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, here is your gift. I
thank you
now and always, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...? Of course. This mission's objective
was to gift
you with this vacation
coupon.
choice_data_list: Are you really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please use it to refresh your body and
mind in the
hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Confusion" detected in Trainer.
Searching for
possible solutions.
choice_data_list: Still, Bourbon won it for us, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
One result found. The coupon is for two,
so I will
accompany you to the
destination as your
luggage bearer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In addition, I will search for relaxation
methods
and plan the most effective hot
spring vacation
itinerary for you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, immediate
implementation of this
plan is
impossible, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is that acceptable?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd feel horrible making her do so much
work, but
I suppose it's better than if she
didn't use the
ticket for herself at all.
choice_data_list: I-I can't let you do something like that!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list: Let's think about it again once things settle down after the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not sure how we should use the
coupon,
but I decide to hold on to it for
now.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission complete. First prize obtained.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It may not be as grand as a vacation
coupon, but
this prize boasts
exceptionally high nutritional
value.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please take this. Thank you for all you
have done
for me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is very kind of you, but...
choice_data_list: Let's eat together, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I cannot comprehend the logic behind
that
statement, but if that is an order,
then I accept.
choice_data_list: It tastes better when we eat together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy the deluxe carrot hamburger
steak
together after we get back!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Results of raffle—second prize. This is
not an
unsatisfactory outcome, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, Trainer. I will use these
carrots for
meal preparation—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon fixes her eyes on the
large pile
of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I've been struck by "inspiration."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With such a large amount of carrots, it
will be
possible to create new dishes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I can complete my
mission by
creating a gift from these!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching for recipes... Results returned
for
multiple recipes, including dishes
from braised
burdock root and namul, to
cookies and cakes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please be in your office at 6:00 p.m.,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At night in my office, she treats me to a
feast
featuring a huge variety of
delicious carrot dishes!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A single carrot...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My sincerest apologies, Trainer. Please
allow me
to show you my appreciation at
a later date.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list: Your feelings came through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stops mid-sentence and looks up as
if
something's caught her eye.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A bag of potatoes is one hundred and
fifty yen...
And one onion is forty yen!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, may I stop by your room at
around 6:00
p.m. tonight?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Please maintain a
state of
hunger until then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At night, Mihono Bourbon visits me with
a
container full of delicious curry.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission failed... I am terribly sorry,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to express my thanks at
a later
date.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm experiencing
"disappointment."
choice_data_list: Your feelings came through loud and clear, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so hard on yourself, young
lady! There's
always next time!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head home with Mihono Bourbon. Her
shoulders
are slumped in defeat the
whole way back.
